subject: riotInterceptor
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: corporate riot-control interceptor with a water cannon and neon light bars.
Style: Cyberpunk 2077.
reasoning:
I'm planning out a single static vehicle module—an armored riot-control truck roughly 5.5m long with box and cylinder parts for the body and six wheels, keeping the design efficient since static models don't need joints.

I'll build the body with a helper function for boxes, use an extruded cab profile for a sloped windshield look, and add details like a water tank, roof turret, glowing light bars, bumper spikes, and camera eyes—working out the coordinate placement relative to a 0.55 wheel radius and chassis height.

Working out the windshield tilt angle so the glass normal faces up and forward, then placing side windows with trim, and adding a horizontal cylindrical fuel tank at the back with rings and end caps, settling on a dark navy body color.

Adding more vehicle details...

Positioning the four wheels symmetrically with fender top plates above each, then adding roof-mounted spotlights, antennas, camera domes with glowing red eyes, a tank hatch, rear ladder rods, a rear light bar and bumper, plus alternating yellow hazard stripe boxes along the lower hull skirts.
